categories.main_business_segments: Taekyung Industry operates through seven main business segments: lime manufacturing and sales, carbon dioxide manufacturing and sales, light bulb production and sales, non-ferrous metals business, fuel business, highway rest area and gas station operations, and other businesses including cosmetics preservatives. Each segment contributes to the company's diversified revenue streams with lime manufacturing being the largest contributor.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes various kiln technologies such as Becker, A.L.C., and rotary kilns for lime production. It employs wet grinding methods for producing ultra-fine calcium carbonate slurry, replacing imported materials. In carbon dioxide production, it manufactures high-purity liquid CO2 and dry ice with advanced dispersion and cleaning systems. The non-ferrous metals segment produces ferroalloys and zinc products using electric furnace technology and has developed proprietary technologies for cosmetic preservatives and environmental materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include steel manufacturers like POSCO and Hyundai Steel for ferroalloys and lime products, paper manufacturers for calcium carbonate, shipbuilding and welding industries for carbon dioxide products, and automotive and general lighting sectors for light bulbs. The highway rest area business serves direct consumers, while the cosmetics preservative segment supplies various cosmetic companies. The company also exports to markets in China, Japan, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: Taekyung Industry primarily operates in South Korea with manufacturing plants and offices located in Seoul, Dangyang, Gwangyang, and other domestic sites. It has overseas investment subsidiaries in Vietnam and exports products globally to regions including China, Japan, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Russia, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures raw and processed materials such as lime, ferroalloys, and carbon dioxide gases, which are essential inputs for steelmaking, chemical, and industrial processes. It also operates retail and service businesses like highway rest areas and gas stations, directly serving end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Taekyung Industry focuses on R&D to develop high-purity and high-functionality lime products, eco-friendly preservatives for cosmetics, and advanced manufacturing technologies such as ultra-fine calcium carbonate slurry production. It holds multiple patents related to desulfurization agents, adsorption technologies, and manufacturing methods. The company aims to enhance product quality, expand environmental-friendly product lines, and strengthen technological competitiveness to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales across its manufacturing segments including lime, carbon dioxide, ferroalloys, and light bulbs. It also earns income from operating highway rest areas and gas stations through direct consumer sales. Export sales contribute to revenue, and the cosmetics preservative business supplies products under contract to cosmetic manufacturers. Revenue is derived from both domestic and international markets with a mix of cash and credit sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taekyung Industry holds a leading position in the domestic lime manufacturing sector with the largest production capacity. It competes with other chemical and materials companies such as Seonhwa Chemical, Changshin Chemical, and SK Materials in the carbon dioxide market. In ferroalloys and zinc oxide production, it maintains significant market share domestically and internationally. The highway rest area business faces competition from other operators but benefits from strategic locations and service differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 656 billion KRW, with a slight decline from the previous year. It maintains a solid financial structure with a debt ratio of 41.24% and equity ratio of 70.80%. Operating profit was 44.1 billion KRW, reflecting a 19.65% decrease year-over-year. The company has shown steady asset growth and maintains strong cash flow and liquidity positions, supporting ongoing investments and operational stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taekyung Industry emphasizes superior product quality, technological innovation, and diversified product offerings as its core value propositions. It was the first in the lime industry to obtain KS certification and ISO9001 quality management certification, underscoring its commitment to quality. The company differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technologies, stable multi-source raw material supply, and a broad product portfolio including eco-friendly and high-performance materials. Its strategic focus on customer satisfaction, supply stability, and environmental compliance further strengthens its competitive edge.
